FOR THE LOVE OF THE DRIVE

A collection with character.

Motora is an independent automotive showcase with ten reference editions from each of ten brands. It is an enthusiast collection, unaffiliated with vehicle manufacturers.

The details matter.

Specifications describe the named reference edition and are not current sales specifications. Figures vary by market, model year, options, and measurement method. PS is metric horsepower; hp is mechanical horsepower. Historical US horsepower may use SAE gross ratings. Unpublished figures appear as a dash. Source links are provided on each car.

Images & 3D models

Gallery images are renders of the credited artist models. Some models have custom body kits, liveries, or equipment that differ from the stock reference edition. Finishes in the 3D garage are illustrative.

Models are supplied by the carros library and retain their original Creative Commons licences. Each detail page and 3D viewer credits the original artist. Read all model credits and licences ↗

Films

Videos are hosted by YouTube and belong to their respective creators. Playing a film connects to YouTube. If a creator restricts embedded playback, use the provided YouTube link.

Saved favourites stay in this browser. No account is needed.
